info.name: Hugging Face Dataset Viewer API
info.description:
Query and visualize datasets stored on the Hugging Face Hub through a lightweight REST API. Get dataset splits, preview rows, search and filter data, access Parquet files, retrieve size statistics, and obtain Croissant metadata - all without downloading the entire dataset.

Contact Support:
 Name: Hugging Face Support
